title: 第13章 你们就想这么跑了第14章 意外收获御兽诀
slug: 太古封神第1516章直接镇压
lines: 今天是见鬼了吗？
先是撞见修炼血雷战技之人，然后又在这个人身上看到了大乾王令。
此物可不是一般人能拥有的，唯有大乾王族才能持有。
而且，不是每一个大乾王族都能拥有大乾王令，只有极个别身份尊贵的人物才有。
紫衫老妪认得出来，这是真的大乾王令，不是仿造之物。
此物材料极其特殊，根本无法仿造。
而且大乾王令有一个特殊的功效，就是别人拿到大乾王令会让令牌黯淡无光，唯有真正持有者，才能让它亮起来。
这一枚大乾王令，正闪烁着淡淡的光华。
紫衫老妪怎么都想不明白，能持有大乾王令的玄天老祖，在大乾王朝之中肯定是身份显赫之人。
甚至能在大乾王朝中拥有极大的影响力。
这样的人，怎么会跑到小小的玄天宗去当老祖？
难道是因为身居高位久了，觉得无趣，所以才跑出来，隐姓埋名地体验一下不一样的人生？
“参见王令之主。”
紫衫老妪连忙下跪行礼。
“今日发生之事，包括血雷战技，以及见到我和大乾王令一事，不得向外泄露，不然我饶不了你。”
玄天老祖沉声说道。
紫衫老妪赶紧应声。
“至于风伯候之子一事，你就如实上报好了，就说玄天宗少主秦云杀的就行了。”
玄天老祖摸着下巴说道。
“如实上报……”
紫衫老妪不解地看向玄天老祖，“王令之主，今日死的虽然是风伯候之子，但却是庶出，您只要出面说一声，应该就可解决此事了……”
“让你如实上报就如实上报，其他事你就别管了，以后有需要你的地方，我会找你。”
玄天老祖漠然说道。
听到最后一句话，紫衫老妪心中顿时欣喜若狂。
原本她就是带罪之身。
没有什么机会的话，这辈子是别想重回大乾刑部了。
但是如果能替王令之主办事，并能获得对方赏识的话，别说重回刑部，说不定还有机会往上爬。
“这是属下的传讯晶，只要王令之主需要，随时可呼唤属下前来。”
紫衫老妪赶紧双手奉上传讯晶。
“可以了，需要你的时候会喊你的。”
玄天老祖收下之后，有些不耐烦地挥了挥手。
紫衫老妪识趣退离。
content_en:
Did you see a ghost today?
First, he bumped into a person practicing blood thunder combat skills, and then he saw Da Gan Wang Ling in this person.
This thing is not something that ordinary people can own. Only the Daqian royal family can possess it.
Moreover, not every Daqian royal family can possess the Daqian Wangling, only a very few distinguished figures can have it.
The old woman in purple shirt recognized that this was the real Daqian Wang Ling, not a counterfeit.
The material of this object is extremely special and cannot be copied at all.
Moreover, the Daqian King Token has a special effect, that is, if someone else gets the Daqian King Token, it will dim the token. Only the true holder can make it light up.
This Daqian Wang Ling is shining with a faint brilliance.
The purple-shirted old woman couldn't figure it out. The ancestor Xuantian who could hold the Daqian King's Order must be a prominent person in the Daqian Dynasty.
It can even have great influence in the Daqian Dynasty.
How could such a person go to the small Xuantian Sect to become an ancestor?
Is it because you have been in a high position for a long time and feel bored, so you run out and experience a different life incognito?
"See the Lord of the King's Order."
The old woman in purple robe quickly knelt down and saluted.
"What happened today, including the blood-thunder combat skills and the meeting with me and Da Gan Wang Ling, must not be leaked to the outside world, otherwise I will not be able to spare you."
Ancestor Xuantian said in a deep voice.
"Yes!"
The old woman in purple robe quickly responded.
"As for Feng Bohou's son, just report it truthfully. Just say that Qin Yun, the young master of Xuantian Sect, killed him."
Ancestor Xuantian touched his chin and said.
"Report truthfully..."
The purple-robed old woman looked at Patriarch Xuantian in confusion, "Master Wang Ling, although the person who died today was Feng Bohou's son, he was a concubine. As long as you come forward and say something, this matter should be solved..."
"If you are asked to report it truthfully, report it truthfully. Don't worry about other things. If I need you in the future, I will look for you."
Ancestor Xuantian said indifferently.
Hearing the last sentence, the purple-shirted old woman suddenly felt ecstatic.
She was originally a sinner.
If there is no chance, there is no chance of returning to the Dagan Punishment Department in this life.
But if he could handle affairs for Wang Lingzhi and be appreciated by him, let alone return to the Criminal Department, he might still have a chance to climb up.
"This is the messenger crystal for my subordinates. As long as the master of Wang Ling needs it, he can call his subordinates at any time."
The old woman in purple clothes quickly handed over the communication crystal with both hands.
"Okay, I'll call you when I need you."
After receiving it, Patriarch Xuantian waved his hand impatiently.
The old woman in purple shirt retreated.
